audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Kennen/Kennen/Skill/Kennen/Kennen/Skill/Skill while the packet reads Kennen, Skill, Garen, Garen, Skill, Garen, Skill — and the prose already concedes 3, 4-5 and first item to Garen.
audit.why: Level 1-2 is Kennen's range advantage; Judgment at 3 plus the Decisive Strike silence flips the short trade; 4-5 is conceded outright with no R; level 6 is the coin-flip equalizer; first item (Stridebreaker / Sundered Sky) is his; late evens out as a teamfight question. The mirror already realigned Garen's side to the packet.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-6 flipped as matched full/content pairs to Skill, Garen, Garen, Skill, Garen, Skill. Level 1 stays Kennen.

audit.why: Spikes are Lvl 1 / Lvl 3 (Judgment) / Lvl 6 (Slicing Maelstrom, flat 120s) / 1st item, which matches both kits: Garen's R is 120/100/80 and executes, Kennen's is a flat 120s aura.
audit.corrected: No change; chart rows realigned to these spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[0] said Garen's Q silence 'cancels your R channel mid-cast'. Slicing Maelstrom is not a channel — Riot's text is 'Kennen summons a storm that strikes at nearby enemy champions', and the kit file carries only a zone flag on it.
audit.why: A silence blocks casting; it does not remove an already-active storm. Written as a cancel, a player will hold R for a silence window that does not exist. Decisive Strike is a flat 8s auto-reset silence at 300 range — the real thing to respect is that it locks the cast out beforehand.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[0] now states the silence prevents casting Q, W, E and R rather than cancelling anything, and the cooldown block names Decisive Strike's 8s with the auto-reset wind-up as the tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown block named Courage with no number and called it the matchup-defining tool.
audit.why: Courage is 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s and is a shield plus brief tenacity, but the ability that decides trades is the 8s Decisive Strike silence.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rebuilt around the 8s silence with Courage's 22s rank-1 number kept as secondary.

edits.after: Walk you down with passive regen up, then land the Decisive Strike silence so you cannot cast Q, W, E or R at all

edits.before: - Garen Courage: matchup-defining — Damage reduction. Trade when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Garen Decisive Strike: matchup-defining — a flat 8s silence on an auto reset that locks your whole kit out. Step back on the wind-up. - Courage (22s at rank 1): shield and tenacity. - Your R: flat 120s, kill windows only.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Garen must walk into your range.
edits.after: Judgment lands at 3: his 8s Decisive Strike silence into the spin beats you, and silenced you never reach the third mark.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Courage's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: No R yet, so you concede his commit window: chip from 950 range and never stand inside the 325 spin radius while his Q is up.
